footer_numbers: Every number comes from a data API. Nothing on this page is written by an AI.
footer_price_only: Changes are price only, without dividends (split-adjusted closes), so they match what Yahoo and Google display.
footer_sources: Prices: Yahoo Finance via yfinance. Rates: US Treasury daily par yield curve (same day), FRED as fallback (one business day lag). Each row shows its own value date.
heatmap_legend: Box size: market cap. Color: 1 day change (blue up, red down). Grouped by GICS sector.
heatmap_skipped: not shown (no market cap or price)
slow_movers_intro: S&P 500 stocks that crossed a long-term threshold on the last trading day, computed from price history. One alert per ticker; inside 90 days a ticker returns only on a higher severity or another 20% move. Sorted by severity, then market cap.
no_slow_movers: No stock crossed a threshold on the last trading day.
suppressed: held back (cooldown, or lower severity than the last alert)
baseline_intro: Every S&P 500 stock currently beyond a slow mover threshold, as of the last close. This is the starting point; the daily brief only reports new crossings.
breadth_line: S&P 500 stocks at a 52 week low vs high
earnings_intro: S&P 500 companies whose 8-K with Item 2.02 (results of operations) was accepted between the previous close and this close.
no_earnings: No S&P 500 company filed results for this trading day.
scanned_note: 8-K filings found for this trading day
chunk_macro: Monday: macro and the week ahead
chunk_business: Tuesday: how the company makes money (10-K Item 1)
not_reported: not reported with the usual tags (banks and REITs report differently)
week_changes: What changed over the last week
competitor_table: Latest fiscal year from company facts
deep_dive_failed: This chunk could not be built
partial_chunk: Part of this chunk is missing
ongoing_intro: Every ticker inside the slow mover cooldown, with its first alert of the current streak and how far it has moved since.
no_ongoing: No ticker is inside the cooldown.
unofficial_banner: Unofficial prices: the official close was not published in time, so today's prices come from the last intraday bar. Changes may differ slightly from the official close.
computed_margin: Computed as gross profit minus SG&A, not reported by the company
bot_welcome: Welcome back. Send /settings to change anything, /pause or /stop.
bot_lang_unavailable: That language is not enabled for you.
bot_predict_usage:
Format: /predict TICKER above|below LEVEL by YYYY-MM-DD because REASON
Example: /predict NKE above 40 by 2026-12-31 because the turnaround is priced too low
Tickers or SPX, NDX, DJI, RUT, VIX, DXY, OIL, GOLD, US2Y, US10Y.
bot_error_ticker: That ticker does not look right.
bot_error_level: The level must be a positive number.
bot_error_date: The date must be YYYY-MM-DD and in the future.
bot_queued: It will be written to the repo on the next build. Queue id
bot_soon: Questions are coming soon. Your message was forwarded.
prediction_intro: Open predictions, results scored on this trading day, and the running hit rate. Scored against the closing price on the due date.
no_predictions: No predictions yet. Send /predict to the bot.
onb_welcome: Welcome to the morning brief. Choose your language.
onb_mode:
Choose the mode.
Full: the whole brief in English with commands.
Simple: one short message a day, no commands.
onb_hour: At what hour should the brief arrive? Choose your local time.
onb_tz: Where are you? Share your location, tap a city, or type a city name.
onb_tz_unknown: I do not know that city. Try another spelling or share your location.
onb_saved: Saved. You will get the brief every morning.
settings_menu: What do you want to change?
paused: Paused. Send /resume to get the brief again.
stopped: Your settings were deleted. Send /start to come back.
simple_soon: Simple mode launches soon. You will get your first brief automatically when it is ready.
stats:
Users: {users} ({full} full, {simple} simple, {paused} paused)
Sends today: {sends}, failures: {failures}
owner_only: This command is for the owner.
full_lang_note: The full brief itself is only available in English. This setting changes the bot's menus and replies.
no_variant_for_lang: There is no version of today's brief in this language yet, so nothing was re-sent.
